d:
Light up your Diwali with "Bijlee Bijlee", now in 8K. Harrdy Sandhu and Palak Tiwari bring the energy, with lyrics and composition by Jaani, music by B Praak, and a video directed by Arvvindr S Khaira.
Turn it up and celebrate. Happy Diwali from Desi Melodies!
Singer: Harrdy Sandhu
Starring: Harrdy Sandhu & Palak Tiwari
Lyrics & Composition: Jaani
Music: B Praak
Director: Arvvindr S Khaira
Choreographer: Rajit Dev
